Title: Musty out of the washer, or sour after drying? Two causes
Description: Musty right out of the washer usually means the machine; sour after drying, bacteria in the fabric. How to tell, and each brand's own cleaning rules.
Keywords: laundry, cleaning routines, appliance efficiency, odors and moisture

Title: Sort the pile that came back to see why it came back
Description: Clutter returns when things lack a home, storage is full, or resets are too far apart. A quick pile audit shows which, plus when it's more than clutter.

Title: Leftovers: 3–4 days in the fridge, reheat to 165°F
Description: Fridge at 40°F by thermometer, food cold within 2 hours, leftovers 3–4 days, reheat to 165°F, plus FDA's power-outage limits and why dates don't decide.
Keywords: food safety, food storage and leftovers

Title: Musty smell? Keep humidity below 60%, ideally 30–50%
Description: A musty smell is usually gas from mold growing on something damp. Find it with your nose and a hygrometer, skip the test kit, and size a dehumidifier right.

Title: Divide kWh by billing days before you blame anything
Description: Split a high electric bill into billing days, price per kWh, and daily use, then adjust for weather. Worked example, heat pump aux-heat trap, meter tests.
Keywords: electric bill, water and gas bills, heating and cooling costs, appliance efficiency
